asset_families.v6: approved composed-quality catalog and preserved composed-quality blocks from approved current library
asset_families.v7: approved flow-v7-compact catalog and blocks from approved current library

catalog_rules.dependency_closure: All selected metadata.requires must be provided. Missing or ambiguous providers fail. Never repair or reorder the frozen recipe.
catalog_rules.node_params: Legacy typed bindings for v1-v5; constructor bindings for v6; final compact metadata bindings for v7. Compare loaded param declarations with approved metadata.
catalog_rules.ordered_refs: Constructor refs retain their stored order. Catalog requires arrays express semantic requirements and never replace constructor refs. Preserve parent,child for schema batch and migration tail; head,parent,child for tests test.
catalog_rules.post_validation: v6 composed::validate_plan_with(prompt,dsl,quality_catalog); v7 flow::validate_plan_with(prompt,dsl,compact_catalog). Assemble uses independent semantic admission, not reference equality.
catalog_rules.provider_match: Match full provides symbol, all declared capability constraints and declared role/query kind to exactly one primary. Never use first-match.
catalog_rules.required_symbols: Provide catalog required_common and chosen required_database symbols, all supplied app operation symbols, storage_common when selected storage != none, and each selected flow helper symbol exactly once.
catalog_rules.selection_only: Primary tables select IDs and check closure. They do not set emitted names/refs/order. Emission follows composed/compact_flow emission_recipe.

emission_recipe.added_node_fields: Name is suffix of standard metadata provides; params are standard metadata bindings; refs are same-slot requirements in metadata array order. Preserve existing node refs.
emission_recipe.app_tail_refs: Every current app node name in current order except tail and app. Includes head, supplied routes, workflow.
emission_recipe.base: Start with composed.emission_recipe for flow::base(prompt). Do not emit catalog topological order. Set DSL version som.dsl.v3 and the standard lowered flow tree.
emission_recipe.compact_final_mapping: Map each original composed/standard slot to compact catalog slots. Keep flow.* IDs; otherwise prefix compact. exactly once. Replace all block params with final compact metadata bindings. Preserve file positions, block positions, block names and refs arrays.
emission_recipe.direct_compact_implementation: The exact base_id_to_final_compact_id table replaces standard prefix checks in Rust. Added node IDs are compact-prefixed as final mapping states. Read final compact provides/refs/bindings directly: public catalog comparison proves slot/provides/requires/capabilities/query/operation/routes/authorization/transaction unchanged by compact conversion. Do not read standard templates or builders at runtime.
emission_recipe.helper_file_position: Append one flow_helpers file after all inherited files, after integrations. Mongo migrate.py remains at old migration position.
helper_ids_order: deduplicated selected standard flow and undo IDs sorted by UTF-8 bytes
emission_recipe.helper_node_fields: For each ID in the exact helper order, name is suffix of standard metadata provides, params are standard metadata bindings, refs are same-flow_helpers requirements in metadata array order.

ordered_additions.position: insert immediately before final tail block
ordered_additions.tail_ref_action: append journal after existing parent,child refs

emission_recipe.standard_id_revision: For each existing block ID i in its current file/node position, use v7.i iff that exact ID exists in the approved standard flow-v7 catalog. A replaced block gets standard metadata bindings. Otherwise preserve ID/params. This occurs before compact mapping.
emission_recipe.symbol_refs: After all standard edits, replace each refs string NAME with exactly {symbol:NAME}; preserve array order.

api_blocks_order: supplied route names in supplied order
emission_recipe.base: Use legacy v5 related and business constructors with unchanged package/resources/relation/capabilities/migration. Route entries come from supplied v6 operations only, in supplied order. Preserve v5 file positions, including Mongo migrate.py at the old migration position.

ordered_ref_overrides.name: tail
ordered_ref_overrides.refs_rule: head; supplied route names in supplied order; workflow

flow_rules.byte_preservation: Preserve all scalar representation and literals, typed runtime refs, errors, predicates, exports, results and names. No business operation repair.
flow_rules.helper_set: Exact selected provider/undo IDs from all supplied nodes. Emit in compact_flow.emission_recipe helper order, not generic topological order.
flow_rules.inverse_provider: Object put uses selected storage. Database mutations use selected database. flow.if has no provider capability.
flow_rules.node_transform: Clone supplied node, remove op, insert selected id. Recursively transform transaction steps and if then/else. Replace nonnull undo name with matching inverse primary ID. Preserve all other members and every supplied array order.
flow_rules.primary_selection: Match operation, inverse/null, provider_family, provider_choice and all declared capability constraints to exactly one compact_flow.flow_primary_providers row. Object operations use storage family and prompt.storage choice; other operations use database family and prompt.database choice; if uses neutral/null. Undo inherits storage family for object.put and database family for other mutations. This prevents delete_created inverse ambiguity when both database and storage are present.
flow_rules.tree_shape: name, steps, result from prompt.flow; inputs remains in original prompt.
flow_rules.v7_resolution: Root uses existing flow_compact::resolve/assemble with the compact catalog. Generic resolve_prompt_refs dispatch selects standard flow::resolve and is not appropriate for compact plans.

legacy_node_rule: declared_params records approved parameter types only. Emitted DSL params are typed $ref bindings from the version binding map, never these type strings or copied prompt values.

nodes.name: batch for batch, otherwise scope_action
nodes.path_binding: batch.path for batch; scope.item_path for get/patch/delete; scope.path for create/list

5.param_rule: For each selected block, emit exactly its declared params with common bindings then role bindings then route-path override. Fail if any declared key has no binding.

purpose: Compile primary selection only. Assembly admits any independently valid supported alternative, including checked flow IDs. No equality to this primary plan is required for assembly.

qualification.scope: Only public som-rs/examples/composed-prompt.json and explicit design variations of database, read flow, transaction plus object put. No model/corpus rows.
qualification.v6_public_example_unformatted_source_equ: true for both databases; no general or formatted output claim
qualification.v7_standard_to_compact_reference_exact: true on four public-example design variants; public constructor recipe frozen above

runtime_inputs: Validated prompt and installed approved loaded block/catalog assets only. No Python constructors, corpus tables, model, CNL path, network, environment or scoring.
